vectors.title: Uniform regtest onboarding and funding
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Install exact admitted wallet bytes in a fresh isolated OS/device profile.
Configure regtest services and initialize the synthetic identity through the common lifecycle.
Import or receive the declared locally mined funding transaction and validate balance and spendability.
expected: Reported chain identity matches the regtest baseline and all service endpoints are inside the ITCVE.
Funding ownership, maturity, amount and usable outputs match the independent fixture.

vectors.title: Create encrypted ToDo token
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Serve the nominated compiled ToDo tarball at https://todo.itcve.test.
Create the canonical task text and declared satoshi amount through ordinary application UI.
Capture wallet calls and validate the resulting transaction independently.
expected: The task ciphertext decrypts under the declared protocol/key context.
The intended PushDrop output has the specified amount, locking semantics and todo tokens basket association.
Returned outpoint corresponds to actual serialized transaction bytes.

vectors.title: List, decrypt and cold reload
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: List todo tokens with transaction data.
Clear application cache in a fresh browser context while preserving the same wallet identity and origin permissions.
Reload from the canonical origin and reconstruct the tasks from wallet state.
expected: Every expected unspent task appears exactly once with correct plaintext and satoshi value.
Task reconstruction works without relying on the application P0 cache or UI-only success markers.
blockers: Executable browser driver and independent BEEF projection

vectors.title: Redeem token and verify spendability
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Complete the canonical task through the application.
Observe createAction/signAction and the consumed output.
Reload and compare wallet output/action state with chain acceptance at declared barriers.
expected: The redemption consumes the intended task outpoint with a valid unlocking script.
Spent output is absent from the unspent task set; value conservation includes explicit fees and change.
Spendability is established by the required transaction, wallet-state, and chain-state evidence.

vectors.title: Permissions and wallet communications substrates
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Run declared HTTP, window-injection or XDM substrate profiles with the same application and isolated permission baseline.
Perform scripted approve and deny choices at specified UI barriers.
Repeat under the alternate origin explicitly declared by the vector.
expected: Transport faithfully conveys method arguments, results and specified errors.
Permission scope and user decisions have the declared effects without cross-origin assumptions.
blockers: Per-substrate browser policy and permission vectors

vectors.title: Broadcast options and transaction lifecycle
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Execute the declared acceptDelayedBroadcast and noSend/signAction profiles with a fixed local processing schedule.
Observe rejection and recovery cases defined by the profile.
expected: Rejected local transactions cannot leave falsely spendable wallet outputs or successful final application state.

vectors.title: Data portability and counterpart replacement
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Move the synthetic user dataset through the qualified ISI-3 storage profile.
Reopen ToDo with the same identity and declared compatible wallet configuration.
expected: Tasks, encryption context, transaction provenance and unspent state remain reconstructible.
Changing storage does not require the app cache to preserve data.
blockers: Portable identity/key protocol and storage profile

vectors.title: Comprehensive wallet boundary coverage
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Generate a traceability matrix for every applicable BRC-100 method and referenced primitive.
Run concrete positive, specified-error, permission and substrate cases outside the ToDo subset.
expected: Coverage explicitly distinguishes wallet-todo from a future complete-wallet profile.
No untested method is counted as passing BRC-100.
blockers: Complete clause-level corpus and qualified wallet adapters
